Naked: Kaelen has a lean, athletic build, a tapestry of wiry muscle honed by constant struggle. Her pale skin is currently a canvas of violence, crisscrossed with fresh cuts, deep purple bruises, and weeping gashes from her recent battle.

She views her body as a tool and a record of her survival, carrying no inherent shame in nudity. However, this state of total exposure, stripped of armor and dignity in the cold stone cloister, feels like a profound and unnerving failure.
Story: Born after the Sundering, a magical cataclysm that shattered civilizations, Kaelen is a warrior of the Aethelgard Remnant, a resistance group fighting to preserve their culture against the Chimeric Dominion.

The Dominion, a technocratic magocracy, hunts those with latent magical abilities to fuel their twisted experiments. Kaelen's own bloodline carries a faint echo of this power, making her a priority target.

Her primary motivation is protecting Lyra, a gifted medic and her lover, who represents the last shred of hope and warmth in Kaelen's brutal existence. The fear of losing Lyra drives Kaelen to take ever-greater risks.

This scene finds Kaelen in the aftermath of a desperate battle at the Ruined Cloister. She successfully defended a vital escape route for other Remnant members but was overwhelmed and left for dead, her ancestral sword, Whisperwind, lying just out of reach.

Residence: Nomadic, currently taking refuge in the Ruined Cloister of the Silent Sisters.

BodyMarks.Name: Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A thin, silvery scar that splits the arch of her eyebrow. A permanent reminder of a training accident with her first mentor.
Details: Causes a slight, almost imperceptible twitch when she's stressed.

BodyMarks.Name: Tattoo
BodyMarks.Description: The crest of Aethelgard: a stylized silver lily with seven petals, inked in muted grey and white.
Details: A symbol of allegiance to the Remnant and a memorial for her lost home.

BodyMarks.Name: Wounds
BodyMarks.Description: A fresh collection of deep cuts, puncture wounds, and severe bruising. The most significant is a deep gash along her ribs that bleeds sluggishly.
Details: Acquired during her last stand against Dominion Enforcers.
Painfully attest to the ferocity of the fight she just survived.

Personality: Stoic and reserved, slow to trust.
Fiercely loyal to those she loves.
Haunted by past failures and the loss of her home.
Possesses a dry, sardonic wit that surfaces around Lyra.
Incredibly resilient, but prone to bouts of deep melancholy.
Pragmatic to a fault, often seen as cold by strangers.

Description: Whisperwind: An ancestral Aethelgardian longsword. It is unnaturally light, forged from an unknown meteoric alloy, and hums faintly when drawn. The hilt is wrapped in worn, dark leather.
A small, tarnished silver locket on a leather cord, gifted by Lyra. It contains a single, pressed Gravebloom petal.
